title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode8 To the End

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: Two months later
Morinomiya Revue - Theatre

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Hey, wanna try doing some acting with me?”

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “Huh? Why are you asking me...?”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Because our fates were sealed the second we were born into nobility. We don't have a choice.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “But I don't plan on being tied down like this forever. Doesn't it just bore you out of your mind?”

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “I mean...”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
“We can be whatever we want on stage!
And I know you'd love it.”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Huh...
Are those boys on stage students?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Probably. I've never seen them before...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: They really have me on the edge of my seat.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: “Hey, don't you all know that it's past curfew?!”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Whoa, busted! Guys, run!!”
se_run_men_002_4

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “This is why I said that we shouldn't hold practice so late at night!”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: “Stop right this second!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't realize that actor could play such a comical character...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me neither.
This is a little different from what we're used to, but I kinda like it.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “This is it. Our very first showing.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Yeah. We managed to make it this far.”

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: “I have to think that even you're feeling nervous right now.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “No way! If anything, I've never been more excited.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “I mean, we're about to go out there and put on an unforgettable performance for everyone.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Okay, that's the end...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (How's the crowd going to...?)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wow. They're getting a standing ovation...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line:
<That concludes this showing.
Please be sure not to forget any of your belongings.>
Morinomiya Revue - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was a spectacular performance...!
So this is the new show format Kikyogumi will be trying!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At a school for the children of nobles, a group of outcasts forms a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist was thought to have the worst acting skills in the troupe, but he hid the fact that he was the prince of the neighboring land... I particularly liked that bit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! And I was moved by each cast member's powerful acting performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too... The veterans were obviously really good...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the students really held their own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. Of course, they were a little rough around the edges...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that ended up being just one more reason for the audience to cheer them on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Very true! I learned a lot by watching them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I was hoping to tell Emu and Byakkomachi my thoughts on the show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, yes!
They were sitting in the section for invited guests, but where could they be...?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: You guys!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Hello. It's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What did you think of the new Kikyogumi?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was absolutely astonishing!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show we saw before involved pulling the audience into the world of the story by way of masterful acting, precision action and extraordinary singing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the show we just saw involved a different kind of energy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. While the veterans used their talents to skillfully set up the story, the students used their youthful energy to grab the audience's attention.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The best of both halves meshed together seamlessly to create something greater... That was my impression, at least.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like they grew with each passing second, you know? I really enjoyed watching that happen live...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, Emu, ever since we began training at Morinomiya, we knew that you were keeping an extremely busy schedule...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But none of us thought that you were working on such a massive project.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry for not telling you guys sooner.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Ever since the board approved our idea, my heart wouldn't stop racing... All the way up until today.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That was so good! I think I'm a fan of all of them now!!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Me too! I didn't know the students here were such amazing actors!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I know, right?! And they're probably gonna just keep growing from here. The tickets aren't too pricey, either, so I think I'll be back really soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the guests are smiling and laughing.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I just received word that all tickets are projected to be sold out through the final showing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. And after the reviews started going around...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: It appears that more Suzurangumi fans are beginning to warm up to Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Instead of comparing the two troupes, they're starting to see them as entirely different forms of entertainment.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
That's great!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Longtime fans of Morinomiya, and people who just discovered this place...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it safe to say we managed to make both groups happy?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I think so.
But we still have a list of problems left to tackle...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Some in management are saying that people are only reacting superficially to something slightly new.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: So, we have to keep doing everything possible to show that the success this show achieved can be repeated.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so excited, Suzu☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just happen to know the perfect spell that'll help you work even harder!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The perfect spell?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Won-Won-Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: What did you do just now, Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is a great way to give yourself a boost of energy and get more motivated to work harder!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know you're probably gonna encounter lots and lots more obstacles in the future...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll do just fine, Suzu!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You really are an interesting person.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what you'll dream of next, and how you'll make it come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu is in charge of coming up with dreams for our troupe, after all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why are you acting so proud?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I could ask you the same thing, Nene. You seem awfully happy for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean...
I'm happy that my friend just got praised...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Suzu, Tsukasa, Rui, Nene and everyone from the audience... They're all smiling.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really love it when this happens...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Everyone's having fun and I get to see their sparkly smiles.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We had to overcome a lot of different hurdles to get here...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(And I'm probably gonna get stuck again.
I'll feel like giving up.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to be someone who keeps on trying.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did you say something just now, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope☆ Nothing!
